title: Mom Watches Baby Daddy Kill Their Son
description:
Jacksonville police respond to a chaotic scene after witnesses report a man running over an infant at a busy intersection. Bodycam footage shows officers piecing together what happened to 8-month-old Pablo Golden, the arrest of his father Justin Golden, and the conflicting stories that followed. Watch the investigation unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
